## What's changed

- A short sparkle animation leads straight into Plural Star. No boot menu or extra button to press.
- Open **Settings → sparklecat's mods** to manage included features.
- **Wallpaper** and **Storage tools** have saved on/off switches. Disabling wallpaper keeps your chosen image for later.
- General feature names and descriptions throughout the patcher and mod menu.
- Backup and restore controls live in Settings. Confirmed restores apply automatically after a cold restart, before the app or syncing starts. Use **Open app settings → Force stop**, then reopen Plural Star. Pending restores can be canceled; disabling Storage tools cancels them too.
- The intro respects reduced-motion settings, and the menu follows the app theme and existing app lock.

Download **sparklecat-plural-star-mods-0.2.0-debug.apk** below. Include the features you want when patching, then turn them on or off in Settings without repatching. Repatch the original APK to update an existing modded installation with the new behavior.

## Compatibility and upgrade

Android 8.0 or later. This patcher accepts the official standalone Plural Star 1.23.3 APK. On a fresh app installation, finish setup to access Settings.

**Save and verify a Plural Star backup outside the app before replacing an existing preview.** Development builds use debug signing certificates, which can differ between builds. If Android requires uninstalling the patcher, that removes its per-device APK-signing key. Newly patched APKs may then require reinstalling Plural Star and restoring your backup. Keep the original installation until the backup is verified.

This is a development prerelease. Automated TypeScript, component, settings, backup, recovery, concurrency, Android build, APK signing, and alignment checks passed. Interactive testing on a physical phone is still pending.

Source code and checksums are attached. See the README for migration instructions and backup details.
